title: seam for the Workflows API base so the phantom cloud run is testable hermetically
body: z7w's cloud half — the phantom 'running' cloud run, a factory record frozen at running with no Workflow instance behind it — is only honestly detectable through the Cloudflare Workflows API, and `factory.SupervisorOptions` pins that base URL to api.cloudflare.com (internal/factory/supervisor.go: `CloudflareAPIBase`, never set by internal/cli's cloudSupervisorOptions). A seam there (an env var or credential-file key) would let the Bombadil suite stub the Workflows endpoint the way it stubs tk and the registry, and hold the phantom-live property from outside the process; today that property needs the operator's Cloudflare credentials and cannot run in CI.
